status: release workstream candidate; not formal release
change: The current index generator no longer sets a 4096-entry or 2 MiB ceiling for successor Search; it preserves the existing limits for frozen Search 0.5.0 and keeps identity, source, WIT and receipt checks.
reproduction: Before the fix, a synthetic 0.6.0 source with 4100 extra declared APIs failed index entry budget; a separate 2 MiB+ description failed index byte budget. Both raw errors are retained.

After the fix, generated 4432-entry and 2161856-byte indexes. Installed candidate Search 0.6.0 Core successfully decoded both on Node, Bun and Deno; the 4432-entry page and final lookup were checked. Synthetic API declarations do not represent 4100 implemented APIs.

A reusable four-fixture regression covers both synthetic 0.6.0 successes and 0.5.0 budget rejection, and passes Node/Bun/Deno. The first attempt had an incorrect module path; original failure retained.
Existing index suite passed 12/12. Current 43-Root Q0 index regenerated byte-identically and its new generator receipt and seven-check release preflight passed.
limitations: Legacy negative tests use synthetic authoring sources declaring 0.5.0; exact frozen 0.5.0 runtime limits are separately checked in search-versioned-page-q1.
The 43-package current index is below the old ceilings; these scale tests use synthetic entries and an enlarged description.
This removes two index-generator caps, not all platform/runtime memory limits; no production deployment, Source admission, CI or formal release.
